_README: Campus Administrative Office, extracted from the PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 Edition (Internal Services pp. 1383-1420 and External Services pp. 588-662). 36 services. effective_from 2025-01-01 is an ASSUMPTION (edition year start); replace if the Charter prints an effective date. Each service lists all Charter transaction types in transaction_types. Review before importing. Standards carry duration_days, duration_hours and duration_minutes exactly as printed. See CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 6. Each service also carries service_scope (INTERNAL or EXTERNAL, from the Charter section it was printed in); see CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 7.

services.service_name: Circulation Services
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Sign in the Client logbook in the office receiving area Location: Administrative Office PUP campus
  1. Give the logbook to the client [Responsible: Administrative Staff Administrative Office PUP Campus]
Step 2. Submit letter of intent to Administrative Office* Location: Administrative Office PUP Campus Notes/Instruction: *No need for step # 2, only signing in the logbook and borrower's slip are needed
  2.1. Accept approved letter of intent [Responsible: Administrative Staff Administrative Office PUP Campus]
  2.2. Acknowledge receipt of letter of intent stamped with "Received" and accepts [Responsible: Administrative Staff Administrative Office PUP Campus]
  2.3. Check availability of equipment based on quantity requested and scheduled date [Responsible: Administrative Staff Administrative Office PUP Campus]
  2.4. If available- requestee will be requested to fill out the borrowers Slip [Responsible: Administrative Staff Administrative Office PUP Campus]
  2.5. Borrower slip number/code will be given for claiming of borrowed items. [Responsible: Administrative Staff Administrative Office PUP Campus]
  2.6. If not available requestee will be immediately informed [Responsible: Administrative Staff Administrative Office PUP Campus]
Step 3. Return to the Administrative Office a day before the date of use and present the borrowers slip number/code. Location: Adminisrative Office, PUP Campus
  3.1. Verify the presented borrowers slip number / code. [Responsible: Administrative staff]
  3.2. Require the client to submit PUP ID as collateral for the borrowed items. [Responsible: Administrative staff]
  3.3. Issue the equipment to the client [Responsible: Administrative staff]
Step 4. After the use of the borrowed items, return to Administrative Office with a maximum of 1 day from the date of borrowing. Location: Administrative Office, PUP campus
  4.1. Check the interns [Responsible: Administrative staff]
  4.2. Return the ID to the requestor. [Responsible: Administrative staff]

services.service_name: Consultation and Treatment Services for Emergency Dental Cases of Faculty and Administrative Employees (With Referral)

services.service_name: Issuance of Medical Clearance for On-the-Job-Training of Students (With Referral)
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Proceed to the receiving area of the medical clinic and Location: Medical Clinic, PUP Campus
  1. Ask the purpose of medical clearance. [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]
Step 2. Present requirement for issuance of medical clearance. Location: Medical Clinic, PUP Campus
  2.1. Check the patient's requirements. [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]
  2.2. Take the patient's vital signs (Blood Pressure) [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]
  2.3. Assist the student to the consultation area. [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]
Step 3. Proceed to the consultation area and present documents. Location: Medical Clinic, PUP Campus
  3.1. Assess/Evaluate laboratory results upon receipt of the document. [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]
  3.2. Takes medical history and performs physical examination [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]
Step 4. With Referral Location: Medical Clinic, PUP Campus
  4. Explain the purpose of the referral and prepare a referral form for laboratory/consultatio n to the specialist. [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]
Step 5. Fill out and sign the Daily Treatment Record. Location: Medical Clinic, PUP Campus
  5. Assist patient in filling out the Daily Treatment Record. [Responsible: Physician/Nurse]

services.service_name: Request for the Reservation of Campus Facilities (If Available)
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Present Letter of request duly signed and approved by the Campus Director Location: Administrative/Director's Office, PUP Campus
  1. Issue request form to the client [Responsible: Administrative Staff]
Step 2. Secure Request for the use of Facilities Form at the Administrative Office Location: Administrative/Director's Office, PUP Campus
  2. Have the client/s affix their names to the office logbook for control and reference [Responsible: Administrative Staff]
Step 3. Fully accomplish the form Location: Administrative/Director's Office, PUP Campus Notes/Instruction: Fully accomplish the form: (1) Requesting Party/Person; (2) Department/Office; (3) Purpose of Request; (4) Date Requested; (5) Date to be Used, Facility and equipment requested; (6) Have the filled-up form signed by the Adviser/Head of Office; (7) Return the filled-up form to the Administrative Office for Approval
  3. Receive the filled-out request form and check for the availability of the facility/equipment requested for the date of use on the request form. [Responsible: Administrative Staff]
Step 4. If Available Location: Administrative/Director's Office, PUP Campus
  4. Forward the request to the Administrative Officer for Approval [Responsible: Administrative Staff]
Step 5. Receive the approved request form from the Staff of the Administrative Office and wait for the requested date to use the Facility. Location: Administrative/Director's Office, PUP Campus
  5. Issue One (1) copy of the request to the client and have the other copy on file. [Responsible: Administrative Staff]
